simple.meaning: קָמַל (qâmal) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to wither.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 19:6. Its contexts include land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָמַל (H7060).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קָמַל (qâmal) / H7060 is traced through Isaiah 19:6, Isaiah 33:9 as a generated source-based concept entry.
